standard.title: Share narratives and observations
standard.description: share narratives and observations, using sources and terms about the past and places
standard.prior_knowledge: Students can tell stories about their own experience. No formal prior HASS inquiry skills curriculum.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students share narratives and observations about the past and places, using sources and subject-specific terms for time and location.

nodes.label: Using time and place vocabulary
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can use basic time terms (then, now, yesterday, today, tomorrow) and location terms (near, far, above, below, beside, opposite) correctly in spoken communication.
nodes.minimum_width: Use at least two time terms and two location terms correctly in describing a familiar event or place.
nodes.typical_width: Use a range of time and place terms appropriately when talking about their own experiences, family events and familiar places; demonstrate understanding of the terms through actions, drawings and talk.
wider: Collect and compare time terms used by different family members or cultural groups (e.g. 'the old days', 'back then', 'once upon a time')
Use location terms to describe directions during a walk or observation of the school grounds
nodes.hinge_reason: Without subject-specific vocabulary for time and place, students cannot share narratives or observations in HASS-specific terms — the vocabulary is the communicative tool for the next node.

response_modes.reason: Vocabulary consolidation through frequent, contextualised use — in transition, observation, discussion and labelling — before expecting students to deploy it in narratives.

success_criteria: Uses at least two time terms correctly in context
Uses at least two location terms correctly in context

nodes.label: Sharing narratives and observations using sources
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can share a narrative about a special place or family event using photographs, artefacts or drawings as sources, and use subject-specific terms for time and place.
nodes.minimum_width: Share a spoken narrative about a special place or family event using at least one source (photograph, drawing, artefact) and at least one time or place term.
nodes.typical_width: Create a display or oral presentation about a special place or family event using multiple sources; use time and place terms accurately throughout; explain the significance of the event or place.
wider: Share a narrative that connects a present event or place to the past using terms like 'then' and 'now'
Use a pictorial map or timeline as a source when sharing an observation about a place or event

response_modes.reason: This node brings together source use, vocabulary and personal narrative — the communicative endpoint of Foundation HASS inquiry.

success_criteria: Shares a narrative about a special place or family event using at least one source
Uses at least one time term and one location term correctly in the narrative
